ambiguous_matches.reason: gemini-4-hydrogen cited the officechai.com article covering the Trainium/TPU InferenceX-joining announcement; its headline also names the AgentX benchmark, so it is grouped with the InferenceX/AgentX tweet rather than the separate Amazon-first-Trainium3 tweet.
deepseek-v4-pro titled this story 'Trainium and TPU Beat Nvidia GPUs on Performance per Dollar', matching the InferenceX/AgentX announcement tweet, not the Amazon-first Trainium3 tweet.
sonnet-5-5 described the TPU+Trainium InferenceX addition at 1.2x-2.5x perf per dollar, the second SemiAnalysis announcement; kept distinct from the Amazon-first 2.28x tweet.
gemini-4-argon cited the Amazon-first Trainium3 2.28x tweet; kept distinct from the TPU+Trainium InferenceX announcement.
